credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/lily.py. Reference photo water_lily/adult.jpg by David Stanley from Nanaimo, Canada (CC BY 2.0), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Victoria_Amazonica_Flower_(14013432784).jpg: used as a drawing reference, not traced. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: WHITE: Victoria's outer petals are genuinely white (each shaded with a pink crescent, split by black). LOOMING. Intro: the bloom unfurls: the reflexed white arm petals lift high while the pink crown spreads, hold, then the arms sweep down into the display; the tray and stalk hold. The white petals are shaded with crisp pink crescents round the pink crown. Sport: 'Escarboucle'. Nymphaea 'Escarboucle' (Latour-Marliac, 1909): deep crimson flowers over darker, bronze-tinged pads (indexes 1-2 only). The giant sport is the CRIMSON LILY of Bloom Lake.
